integrity: Analytic proof of finite-density uniqueness and asymptotic laws; independent randomized finite checks support identities only, not historical novelty or independent proof validation.
scientific_limitations: Known homogeneous rate or fixed known event count, one exact saturated bit, a deterministic nonadaptive sampling time and square-loss estimation of cumulative count area. No false positives, missed events, arbitrary intensities, unknown-rate inference, multiple readings or adaptive strategies.
title: Saturation shifts optimal one-bit quadrature to the first-arrival timescale
